milestones.title: adaptive quality tiers and local assistance

gates.criterion: Model-specific decode, coordinates, crop/projection transforms, real preview/generation consumers and stable target identity. Trace exact tensors, pixels, PTS, model and source identities.
gates.previous_boundary: Authored geometry/worker contracts have regression coverage. Revalidate real source/model/view consumers; a green helper test does not prove faithful tracking.
gates.next_proof: Recheck pinned model/source/view through real preview and generation; retain tensor/pixel/PTS and target-identity comparisons.

gates.criterion: Preserve pauses/shallow excursions, prevent invented flat-signal strokes and amplitude expansion, retain timestamp/identity/reacquisition boundaries.
gates.previous_boundary: Deterministic invariants are separate from real-media correctness. Compare independently checked references and retain missing/extra/reversal/travel errors.
gates.next_proof: Compare pauses, shallow motion, reversals and missing/extra travel against independent aligned references.

gates.criterion: Source-matched target/view annotations, checked script alignment, curated category coverage and independent held-out scoring.
gates.previous_boundary: User reports no existing annotations. Live references are permitted for training; sterile references are evaluation-only. Do not fabricate labels or promote optimizer fitting into useful quality.
gates.next_proof: Create and independently check source-matched view/target labels and script timing; freeze training and held-out splits.

gates.criterion: Shared GUI/CLI/batch/live motion semantics, neutral six-axis master, timestamp/clock provenance, source/candidate identity and explicit uncertainty.
gates.previous_boundary: Validate the same operation through actual consumers; detached staging or helper output is insufficient.
gates.next_proof: Exercise identical editing/generation semantics through shipped CLI, desktop and browser, including stale/revoked requests.

gates.criterion: Protected edits, explicit unlock/replacement, candidate review/commit, rebase, undo/redo and restart preservation.
gates.previous_boundary: Authored edit/recovery contracts and selected native desktop scenarios exist. Broader crash, storage, rendered workflow and human effort remain independent.
gates.next_proof: Complete rendered edit/review/commit/undo/restart and crash/storage fault scenarios against preserved user work.

gates.criterion: Revision-bound native project migration, per-axis result/partial status, standard funscript export, archival exact receipt recovery and Stash publication without replacing existing work.
gates.previous_boundary: Preserve old models/pipeline provenance and source-time semantics; damaged/unknown schemas must refuse explicit recovery.
gates.next_proof: Repair current format-15 build, then verify complete attempt history through export, clone, restart, re-export and second clone.

gates.criterion: Real pinned Fast/Default/Maximum pipelines, model-specific adapters and actual active provider disclosure; no placeholder substitution.
gates.previous_boundary: Distinct bounded visual-detector Fast/Default/Maximum plans execute with a pinned CPU model and candidate-bound receipts. This does not select useful default models, establish quality/speed floors, cover other input families or qualify GPU vendors. Rebenchmark permitted candidates before targeted fitting.
gates.next_proof: Select distributable useful models; measure complete quality, speed and memory for every advertised tier/provider.

gates.criterion: Local structured target/settings/review/edit proposals, current owner/project/revision binding, separate approval and protected undoable effects.
gates.previous_boundary: Actual pinned Qwen3 proposal/status gates and authored effect/recovery tests are scoped evidence. Bundled/default assistant selection and useful task quality remain open.
gates.next_proof: Qualify useful offline defaults and approved target/settings/review/edit tasks through actual clients.

gates.criterion: MEM-01/MEM-02 and TEST-13: real generation pause/checkpoint, assistant response, resumed job and protected live playback under contention.
gates.previous_boundary: Logical admission loans, exact-handle retirement and automatic release-driven retry have tests. A separate pinned YOLO11/Qwen3 CPU run pauses and automatically completes the same job from its unchanged initial input basis. First-attempt inference before pause, partial progress, GPU/native/live continuity and whole-application peaks remain open.
gates.next_proof: Verify partial-progress pause/resume and assistant/live coexistence on actual CPU/GPU workloads with whole-application peaks.

gates.criterion: All specified file/stream/audio/text/still-image-plus-prompt/script input families; clear unsupported/undecodable/partial results.
gates.previous_boundary: Qualify a finite container/codec/scheme/script matrix and prompt handling through shipped consumers. Core baseline coverage must work without optional packs.
gates.next_proof: Run the full specified media/codec/scheme/script/prompt matrix through shipped consumers and baseline offline assets.

gates.criterion: Faithful visual motion takes precedence over conflicting rhythm; creative reinterpretation requires explicit intent.
gates.previous_boundary: Keep faithful scoring separate from the agreed creative rubric, timing/pattern constraints and correction effort.
gates.next_proof: Evaluate faithful visual motion versus conflicting rhythm; score creative intent separately.

gates.criterion: Neutral six-axis outputs, VR/stereo/projection handling, explicit per-channel lineage, observability and limitations.
gates.previous_boundary: Secondary-axis quality and creative metrics require their own criteria and independent evaluation. Missing axes cannot silently truncate prior scripts.
gates.next_proof: Establish per-axis observability, secondary-axis/creative scoring and physical six-axis qualification.

gates.criterion: GPU fastest-preset live six-axis; CPU best-effort bounded latest-frame queues, skipped analysis and visible actual delay without stale backlog.
gates.previous_boundary: Measure capture-to-command, presentation synchronization, physical lag, sustained throughput and jitter separately. The 200 ms target's statistical definition remains open; buffered mode does not repair overload.
gates.next_proof: Run actual rendered-browser acquisition and sustained timing/fault scenarios; diagnose retained startup stalls and measure jitter/lag.

gates.criterion: Handy/Handy 2 online and offline BLE, upload consent, arming/disarming, stop/expiry/authority-loss behavior and stale command handling.
gates.previous_boundary: Handy 2 Pro is selected; firmware and encrypted credential setup are unavailable. Codec/RPC fixtures do not prove physical response, stop or synchronization.
gates.next_proof: Identify Handy 2 Pro firmware, configure encrypted credential references and obtain authorized physical sync/stop observations; BLE remains separate.

gates.criterion: MOT-02 through MOT-05: neutral master preserved, timing preserved, amplitude/dynamics/coupled-axis limits enforced and inability disclosed.
gates.previous_boundary: Use qualified device-specific travel/velocity/acceleration/jerk limits; do not assume universal values or normalize shallow strokes to full travel.
gates.next_proof: Validate device-specific travel/dynamic limits while preserving neutral master and timing; measure physical behavior.

gates.criterion: Core includes all baseline Fast input families, local assistant, editing/export and offline playback. Complete is the default full-offline edition and includes every advertised installed tier.
gates.previous_boundary: First launch must not require a network download or user-installed Cargo/Python/inference service. Deliver and execute actual contents, not a manifest claiming missing assets.
gates.next_proof: Deliver actual Core/Complete offline contents, useful defaults and all advertised baseline inputs/tiers.

gates.criterion: Transactional integrity-checked extraction/import/update, interruption/damage/incompatibility recovery, portable data roots and relocation.
gates.previous_boundary: Existing pack/lifecycle tests are scoped evidence. Qualify actual Core/Complete artifacts, disk/extraction limits, interrupted update/rollback, portable credentials and relocation.
gates.next_proof: Qualify extraction/update/recovery/relocation and actual portable artifacts; finish captured/fallback archival history.

gates.criterion: Windows single executable, Linux AppImage, Apple Silicon macOS support and proposed app/dmg packaging; genuine qualified NVIDIA/AMD/Apple/Intel acceleration for every tier.
gates.previous_boundary: Pin exact OS/architecture/driver/backend/model/device subjects. CPU fallback must be disclosed. Other architecture priorities and signing/notarization policy remain as specified.
gates.next_proof: Qualify exact supported OS/architecture/GPU-vendor artifacts and disclose all provider fallback.

gates.criterion: 16 GB system floor; qualified per-tier RAM/VRAM, startup and response deadlines; avoid unified-memory double counting.
gates.previous_boundary: The suggested 12 GB application budget is not an approved hard cap. NVIDIA reference performance/memory configuration cannot silently substitute another board or generalize to other vendors.
gates.next_proof: Measure complete app RAM/VRAM/startup/response behavior on the 16 GB baseline and required tier/vendor matrix.

gates.criterion: Per-category Default stroke precision and recall at least 80%, target 90%; material-error flag recall at least 95% against independent annotations.
gates.previous_boundary: Labels, category protocol and checked source/reference alignment are missing for qualification. Retain >100 ms reversal deviation and >20% neutral travel error as material errors.
gates.next_proof: Independently score aligned held-out categories against Preview precision/recall and material-error recall criteria.

gates.criterion: Required Fast stroke-only paths >1x realtime; reference GPU Fast at least 10x. CPU Default at least 0.5x, reference GPU Default at least 5x.
gates.previous_boundary: Measure complete decode/inference/process/export on the specified 30-minute 1080p/30-fps workload and exact hardware. Do not convert worker-only timing into end-to-end speed.
gates.next_proof: Measure complete decode-to-export performance on the specified 30-minute reference workload and exact hardware.

gates.criterion: Measured human correction effort, applicable test matrix, explicit experimental labels for unqualified six-axis playback and actual preview artifacts.
gates.previous_boundary: The five-human-hour annotation pilot is a method trial, not release coverage. Required regression, native, storage/platform, media/device and human/release gates remain independent.
gates.next_proof: Complete the applicable Preview test matrix and measured human correction protocol with required acceptance.

gates.criterion: Per-category Default precision and recall at least 95%, qualified material-error detection, creative/secondary-axis criteria and physical six-axis behavior.
gates.previous_boundary: No Stable acceptance is established by optimizer fitting, authored fixtures or compiled backends.
gates.next_proof: Meet Stable category and secondary-axis/creative/physical criteria with independent evidence.

gates.criterion: For at least 95% of 30-minute clips per category, no more than five minutes editing and ten minutes total human effort.
gates.previous_boundary: Measure a declared independent human protocol. The 95th-percentile effort agreement does not define the live latency percentile.
gates.next_proof: Measure editing and total human effort on the declared independent category protocol.

gates.criterion: Reproducible exact-source/provider/model/hardware comparisons and SOTA claims only after complete supporting evidence.
gates.previous_boundary: Freeze splits, scoring, preprocessing, artifacts and candidate selection; never use sterile evaluation inputs for training or invent signatures/human acceptance.
gates.next_proof: Freeze reproducible source/model/provider/hardware comparisons before any comparative or SOTA claim.

external_inputs.needed: Firmware/model/configuration, encrypted credential environment names and authorized physical bench observations. Do not paste secret values or create plaintext keys.

Actual endpoint/configuration/library mapping and explicit authorized compatibility run; old owned-fixture compatibility does not qualify the user library.
Exact supported hardware/OS/vendor subjects plus genuine independent human/release evidence.

execution_rules: Use this ledger for current status and priority; keep specifications/ADRs authoritative and historical receipts immutable.
Finish the active build/verification repair before adding unrelated feature work. Follow task dependencies; parallel independent external preparation may proceed.
At a code change, mark working-tree build state unverified until a new subject-bound result exists. Keep the last passing checkpoint separate.
A scoped software completion does not close its parent gate or milestone. Close a gate only against its full criterion and required evidence/human authority.
Preserve all 25 original gates and numeric thresholds. Missing labels, timing, hardware, signatures or acceptance remain explicit; never synthesize them.
After each meaningful task, update the existing JSON item, evidence and source observation; regenerate both views and run --check. Use --audit on the evidence host.
Retain original failures and scope limitations when adding successful successor evidence. Mandatory model reviews remain suspended; independent required acceptance is unchanged.
audit_boundary: Retained source/evidence reconciliation plus fresh rendered desktop pattern and browser local-file recording/export campaigns on pinned pre-format15 app005. Actual browser RGB acquisition is scoped to unbound sterile local video. No fresh current-source build, source-bound clock/continuity campaign, benchmark, model training, device actuation or full roadmap qualification was performed.
product_surface: Source already includes Desktop, CLI and a local browser client over one authenticated Engine; script/project editing, candidate review/commit/export, deterministic patterns, library/Stash controls, local assistant proposals and experimental browser capture. Handy inspection and guarded transport are implemented. Useful learned defaults, the rendered browser-to-device workflow and physical synchronization remain unqualified. See the [app guide](PULSAR_APP_QUICKSTART.md); the gate ledger below retains the remaining acceptance obligations.
cross_milestone_obligations: All explicit TEST scenarios, security/consent requirements, delivery/platform/vendor combinations, open-policy decisions and assurance obligations in the specification/execution plan remain required. A selected test subset cannot close the whole test matrix. Before closing a gate, retain exact subject identities, command/operation results, refusals and interruption outcomes, applicable rendered/native/media/device observations, unresolved failures and the required independent human/release authority. Missing evidence stays open.
